79fef6231d.q: What is the first step Shauna VanderHoek recommends when evaluating an unfinished project?
79fef6231d.a: The first thing is to ask why you are doing the project. Many times it's easy to get started because you think it's a good idea, but you might decide you have more important things to do. Make sure you want to move forward with the project and that it's worth doing before investing time on finishing it.

d258b6a786.q: How should founders communicate project purpose to prevent team momentum loss mid-project?
d258b6a786.a: It's critical to let the team know why you're doing something and the bigger picture of what it will do for the company. Unless they understand the why, they won't have interest in reaching the result. People need to feel part of something that's growing, not just doing drudgery. Getting them back on the mission and vision when momentum flags helps teams re-engage.
